info.nerocolonies.colony_beacon: Place it to found a colony. It claims the ground around it, two founders arrive at once, and from then on the colony builds its own housing and grows. Feed it from the supply row; add upgrade modules to widen the claim or speed up work.
info.nerocolonies.colony_depot: A window onto the colony's shared storage. Every depot in a claim shows the same goods. Put construction materials here and the colony builds four times faster.
info.nerocolonies.housing: Housing. The colony counts every housing block inside its claim; each one raises how many Nerans can live there. Higher tiers are unlocked by research and are more comfortable.
info.nerocolonies.job_station: A job station. Inside a claim it gives the colony a job to work, using colony storage for inputs and outputs. Production stops if morale collapses.
info.nerocolonies.research_station: Spends colony goods and power to unlock research for the whole colony: better housing, more job slots, cheaper life support.
info.nerocolonies.oxygen_generator: Keeps a colony breathing on an airless world. Without it, life support fails, morale falls and work stops. Nerans are never harmed.
info.nerocolonies.outpost_beacon: Place it near one of your colonies to found an outpost: a small remote claim whose job stations feed the parent colony.

gallery.nerocolonies.title: NeroColonies Gallery
gallery.nerocolonies.title.text:
A sandbox colony: it never runs a colony cycle and reports nowhere.
/nerocolonies gallery release starts the held demos.
/nerocolonies gallery clear removes everything.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.farmer: Harvests ripe crops and replants them; sows empty soil from stored seed.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.forester: Fells the nearest trunk into colony storage and replants a sapling on the soil.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.miner: Tends the mine head. Stone, coal and iron arrive on the colony cycle.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.builder: Stands at the building site, which speeds the build. This site is paused: the sandbox runs no cycle.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.hauler: Carries between the colony store (the beacon) and the building site next door.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.cook: Tends the kitchen. Stored food becomes colony rations on the colony cycle.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.toolsmith: Tends the forge. Hands out tools, and makes them from iron when storage has none.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.guard: Walks the watch posts and fights hostile mobs inside the claim. See the guard demo.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.beastkeep: Heals the colony's wounded guardian animals. This wolf starts at a quarter health.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.researche: Tends the study. Redstone and glass arrive on the colony cycle.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.quarterma: Tends the stores, and stocks the Gratitude Cache on the colony cycle.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.medic: Patches up the nearest wounded Neran. The patient here starts badly hurt.
gallery.nerocolonies.behaviour.default: Stands at its post during working hours.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.cache: Stocked with one roll of every stage's gift table.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.needs_board: Shows what the colony is short of.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.planning_table: Lists what the colony can plan. Everything is unlocked here.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.door.text:
Home is inside, the workbench is outside.
The Neran opens the door on its way to work and again on its way to bed.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.maze.text:
The workbench at the end is glassed in.
The Neran walks the maze, replans, tries another side, hops,
then gives up for half a minute instead of pushing at the glass.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.claim.text:
This Neran is held just outside the claim.
Run /nerocolonies gallery release here: it walks back inside first,
then settles at its home by the edge.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.claim.sign: At the south edge of the gallery: x %s, z %s.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.pen.text:
Hostile mobs, sealed in with their AI off.
/nerocolonies gallery release wakes them and opens the pen and the kennel yard.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.guard.text: Attacks hostile mobs inside the claim. Never a player who is not on the Enemy list.
gallery.nerocolonies.demo.kennel.text:
Guardian wolves, raised by the colony from stored bones.
They obey the same target rule as the guards.
